problems: The labels overlap the silhouette and each other, and several are cut off: 'bend of the right wing, the', 'top of the left wing, the le', 'left shoulder, where the lef', 'breast of the gull, the brig' and 'tail, fanned out below the b' are all truncated, and 'breast' sits on top of the wing gold line.
The 'left shoulder' star (around x 210, y 252) sits out on the left wing rather than where the wing joins the body near the breast (about x 296, y 298), so it does not mark the shoulder joint.
The tail is a single narrow point at about (247, 365) hanging down-left of the body. It does not read as a fan of feathers.
The gold lines are straight wireframe segments that cut across the silhouette rather than tracing its outline, so the gold figure and the blue silhouette disagree in places.

The silhouette itself is a real bird shape, not a copy of the gold lines: head at top (about 290, 272), body near (296, 298), wings spread up and out in a V, and the right wing bend and tip (402, 216 and 447, 272) are clearly marked.
output.advice: Keep the overall figure: it is upright (head up, tail down) and reads as a bird with outspread wings. For a cleaner redraw: (1) Move the left shoulder star (64540) to the join where the left wing meets the body, near (285, 285), and keep the top of the left wing (64844) at about (190, 240). (2) Fan the tail: spread the tail star (63901) into a small fan with two or three feather points below the body around (250-270, 340-370) rather than one spike. (3) Shorten the labels or place them outside the figure with leader lines, so none are cut off or sit on the wing lines. Use 'bend of the right wing' and 'breast of the gull' in full, with the breast label moved clear of the body. (4) Make the gold lines follow the blue silhouette outline (wing edges and body), not cut across it.
